rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: A PT portal item of 24 November 2009 says the national president of the PT, Ricardo Berzoini, would give a press conference at 15h on Wednesday 25 November about the result of the PED 2009 held the previous Sunday.

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The item reports that by 20h on 24 November 2009, with 65% of the votes counted, José Eduardo Dutra had 55.9% in the vote for national president, followed by José Eduardo Cardozo, Geraldo Magela, Iriny Lopes, Markus Sokol and Serge Goulart.
